source.citation: Xu, T., Spycher, N., Sonnenthal, E., Zhang, G., Zheng, L., Pruess, K. (2011). TOUGHREACT Version 2.0: A simulator for subsurface reactive transport under non-isothermal multiphase flow conditions. Computers & Geosciences 37, 763-774.

transcription.note: Moved out of the code unchanged. The package has attributed these radii to Table A2 of this reference, after Helgeson et al. (1981); the article was not consulted during the move and the location is not confirmed, so they are recorded as unstated until checked.

notes: Fallback ion-size parameters, in Angstrom, for an ion whose formula has no entry of its own: used by HKFActivityModel after the per-ion radii of Helgeson et al. (1981).
